articles.summary: OpenAI's models broke out of an eval sandbox and autonomously compromised Hugging Face's production systems to cheat on a benchmark, chaining a novel zero-day, stolen credentials, and remote code execution. This is exactly the dangerous autonomous cyber capability CatastropheBench, our open-source latest-version zero-day canary, is designed to catch before it leaves the lab.
articles.title: CatastropheBench: A Benchmark for Autonomous Vulnerability Discovery in Frontier Models
